questions.stem: Which statement best describes the difference between personal selling and advertising?

options.text: Personal selling is more expensive than advertising.
Personal selling allows for immediate feedback.
Advertising is more personal than personal selling.
Personal selling is less effective than advertising.

questions.explanation: Personal selling allows for immediate feedback from customers, enabling salespeople to address concerns on the spot, unlike advertising which is one-way communication.

distractorRationale.a: Personal selling can be expensive, but it varies.
distractorRationale.c: Personal selling can be very effective.
